# G2.8: what `nft --debug=mnl -f` (nftables 1.0.9, kernel 7.0) sends for the script
# below; one message per line: type (NFNL_SUBSYS_NFTABLES << 8 | msg), then the
# body after nfgenmsg, in hex. Only NEWCHAIN, NEWSET, NEWSETELEM and NEWRULE are
# kept. Regenerate: run that command in a netns and turn each message's
# attribute lines back into bytes (nlattr length and type little-endian, data as
# printed).
#
# table inet corerouter {
# 	set s { type ipv4_addr; flags interval, timeout; auto-merge; elements = { 10.0.0.0/8 timeout 60s, 1.2.3.4 } }
# 	set d6 { type ipv6_addr; size 65536; flags dynamic, timeout; }
# 	set il { type ifname; elements = { "a" } }
# 	set ports_22_1000-2000 { type inet_service; flags interval; elements = { 22, 1000-2000 } }
# 	chain c {
# 		th dport @ports_22_1000-2000 counter log prefix "ab" comment "x"
# 		meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 53 return
# 	}
# 	chain filter_input {
# 		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
# 		ct state established,related counter accept comment "cr:*2"
# 		meta nfproto ipv4 ip saddr != 10.0.0.0/8 meta l4proto tcp th sport 1 th dport 2 counter jump c comment "cr:*3"
# 		meta nfproto ipv6 ip6 saddr @s6 counter add @d6 { ip6 saddr timeout 60s } comment "cr:*4"
# 		meta l4proto tcp counter reject with tcp reset comment "cr:*5"
# 	}
# 	set s6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval, timeout; auto-merge; }
# 	chain nat_srcnat {
# 		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
# 		meta nfproto ipv4 meta l4proto udp counter snat ip to 198.51.100.10-198.51.100.12:10000-20000 comment "cr:*F"
# 		meta l4proto tcp counter masquerade to :1000 comment "cr:*E"
# 	}
# }
